searchText: We are excited to announce Mousse, an Ethereum 2.0 emulator for local testing of applications on Eth2 data sharding, especially Rollups. Mousse is designed to be “Ganache for Eth2 data sharding”, and we hope it will be useful for development of Eth2 applications! Medium → https://ethereum-mousse.medium.com/mousse-an-ethereum-2-0-emulator-for-local-testing-of-eth2-applications-19af727519ce GitHub → https://github.com/ethereum-mousse/mousse I also joined the initial development. Any feedbacks, questions are welcome! Was looking for the white paper, anyone got a link for me

excerpts.content:
We are excited to announce Mousse, an Ethereum 2.0 emulator for local testing of applications on Eth2 data sharding, especially Rollups. 
Mousse is designed to be “Ganache for Eth2 data sharding”, and we hope it will be useful for development of Eth2 applications!

Medium → https://ethereum-mousse.medium.com/mousse-an-ethereum-2-0-emulator-for-local-testing-of-eth2-applications-19af727519ce
GitHub → https://github.com/ethereum-mousse/mousse
